_comment: Experiment 44, control: at p = 1/2 the walk is a simple random walk, gamma = 1/2 exactly. Allocation of Avena & Thomann 2012 (arXiv:1201.2890) Sec. 3.3 and Fig. 19: n = 2^13..2^16, independent samples at each n, M = 4712, 6120, 6120, 6120 (Fig. 19's legend; the pairing of M with n is assumed in increasing n). Density 1/2, environment at gamma_eff = 1 (rwre_gpu_lazy defaults).
source: Avena & Thomann 2012, J. Stat. Phys. 147, 1041, arXiv:1201.2890, Sec. 3.3, Fig. 19
